 Most recent Most popular Flat at the Etihad published at 13:26 GMT 13:26 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at Etihad Stadium 
 Very flat atmosphere inside Etihad Stadium during the first half and there was a real nervous tension around the place.
 Each misplaced pass was being greeted with groans and there were a smattering a boos at the half-time whistle.
 Work to do for Enzo Maresca at the break.
 7 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:23 GMT 13:23 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Safe to say it is a two horse race between Arsenal and Brighton
 Paul 
 233 107 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'I'm sure they'll be some harsh words at half time' published at 13:21 GMT 13:21 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Fulham have played into pockets and broken off with the runners. 
 City need some fight and spirit into this game. I'm sure they'll be some harsh words at half time and some changes. 
 74 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 45+3 mins 45+3 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Image source, Getty Images And that's the half, one or two boos at the whistle.
 Rodrigo Muniz's goal is the difference, although Erling Haaland had an equaliser controversially ruled out.
 398 87 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45+2 mins 45+2 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 One final chance for Manchester City as Jeremy Doku cuts onto his right but his shot is straight at the keeper.
 88 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing

 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 One of two added on minutes played.
 72 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45 mins 45 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Fulham's Shea Charles is booked for a late challenge on Elliot Anderson in the City half.
 69 114 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'O'Reilly just switches off' published at 13:15 GMT 13:15 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 What is Nico O'Reilly doing? He just switches off. Deal with it, he puts his hands up and waits for something. 
 From 10-year-old you're told you play to the whistle. 
 193 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 44 mins 44 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Vital save! 
 What are Manchester City doing as Oscar Bobb is allowed to run onto the ball from an onside position as the City defenders wait for a flag? 
 Will he make it 2-0? Nah, his shot from a tight angle is saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma who stays big.
 114 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Manchester City continue to pass, pass and pass some more.
 64 120 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:13 GMT 13:13 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 How many of you have triple-captained Erling Haaland today? That'll be why he looks so off it.
 187 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 It's so unusual. Erling Haaland backs into the right position it just comes off the end of his toe, another chance. 
 92 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 41 mins 41 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Erling Haaland's having a poor game by his standards. Nico O'Reilly finds the forward in the box but he completely miscues his shot.
 177 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 40 mins 40 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Eleven behind the ball for Fulham. Five minutes until half-time.
 138 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 39 mins 39 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Image source, Getty Images Elliot Anderson has a shot deflect kindly into the arms of Bernd Leno.
 City are pushing but there's something missing in their attack.
 126 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 38 mins 38 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Manchester City have a couple of corners but Fulham deal with them both competently enough.
 136 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'City need to read the game' published at 13:08 GMT 13:08 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Erling Haaland receives it, lovely pass. He just opens his chest and puts it into the stands, so unlike him. 
 I think they'll be concerned, Fulham are a good team who can build up. 
 But I think they've got to read the game, they can't have this. 
 135 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The law has come to his rescue' published at 13:07 GMT 13:07 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Alan Shearer 
Former England striker and Match of the Day pundit 
 Image source, Getty Images From my perspective the goalkeeper has been very fortunate. He's made the error, but the law has come to his rescue.
 271 197 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:06 GMT 13:06 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Is Haaland rattled by that earlier VAR call?
 196 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 36 mins 36 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Chance for 1-1, surely...no!
 This is the kind of opportunity Erling Haaland buries as he's played in brilliantly by Phil 'Kevin de Bruyne' Foden, but Haaland wellies his effort into row z.
